notes: Follower rows with small indices (AX high word dirty); the node lookup 0x8ffe8 logs EAX and usually returns a node near the target (distances inside sqrt(0x800), moderate, near and beyond the 0x8000 overflow limit); sometimes no node or no target. Random node types and signed speed words, step scale and stack double (sometimes 0 or negative); target modes 1, 0, 2 and random with times around the follower clock. The update 0x37934 and link refresh 0x3856c log EAX; the real abs, truncate and angle routines run.
